quality.review_scope: Main-only source translation independently audited PASS_WITH_LIMITS (audit SHA-256 25b35a83e9077989af75885db56daf07efa1880af146e363fffaa32779eb9b28; title erratum SHA-256 49b351f491b89597c3c017e1fd8d507b435c1ec601f572a756658041fe540870). SI is unverified; as-made ED and calcined SPXRD are not joined to one physical batch; the Table 5 CIF is a limited Si/O framework model, not complete borosilicate or particle geometry; Figures 1-5 crops omit captions, represented by source-located summaries; browser QA and publication-rights review remain pending.
missing_fields: The exact physical batch/sample identifier is not reported; this is the article-level as-synthesized characterization context.
Boron occupancy is not provided in the Si/O/guest-coordinate tables.
The Table 1 direct-methods model is incomplete; do not substitute it for the later Table 2 refined model.
conflicts: Table 1 is an initial partial model, while Table 2 is the later electron-diffraction refinement; these are sequential models, not distinct products.
